blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Cabinet Approves ₹10,000 Crore One-Time ATF Price Stabilisation Corpus for Airlines. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Buffers Scheduled Indian Airlines against 2.5x surge in Aviation Turbine Fuel prices.
Budgetary Support: Disbursed as interest-free advances to Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) for up to 36 months.
Volatility Context: ATF prices surged from ₹60.50/L in March 2026 to ₹142/L in May 2026 due to West Asia crisis.
Cost Impact: ATF accounts for 40% to 60% of airline operating expenses.
ATF cost share in airline operations (40% to 60%) vs support corpus (₹10,000 crore).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
